kjv: he that speaketh in an [unknown] tongue
mine: one who speaks in a tongue
note: The KJV supplies "unknown" (in italics) throughout chapter 14, deciding that the tongues are unintelligible languages; Paul only says "glossa", tongue/language.

kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
mine: If anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.
note: TR imperative "agnoeito" against passive "agnoeitai" (Sinaiticus*, A*, D, F, G); the early text is a sanction (God does not recognize him), not a shrug.
